name: deeplaw-knowledge-os
description: Optional, explicit-use DeepLaw Knowledge Asset and Context Capsule runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Compile reviewed knowledge into bounded Agent context
interface.longDescription: DeepLaw Knowledge OS reads an explicitly selected local vault of human-reviewed Knowledge Assets and compiles task-specific, hash-verifiable Knowledge Capsules. It is isolated from the DeepLaw Legal Pack and exposes no Agent-facing memory writes.
defaultPrompt: Compile a verified Knowledge Capsule for this task
